description: Alté (short for "alternative") is a youth-led, vibrant Nigerian subculture gaining prevalence out of Lagos in the late 2000s and gaining an absolute influence around 2016, that characterizes non-traditional, individualistic self-expression, where it stands out as a creative counterculture against mainstream, conservative societal norms. What started as an underground movement has emerged into a globally recognized lifestyle spanning fashion, film, visual arts and music.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Rebellion, Self-Expression
